title: World Championship Decks 1999: card flavor text

paragraphs.text: It's all fun and games until someone loses an eye.
"From void evolved Phyrexia. Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection. Thus The Grand Evolution began." —*Phyrexian Scriptures*
Greven *il*-Vec lifted Vhati off his feet. "The fall will give you time to think on your failure."
"We decide who is worthy of our works." —Gix, Yawgmoth praetor
A sphere pushes equally in all directions.
The seed of a world's evil.
"My finest warrior was lost to the Phyrexians. I pray that Lady Selenia died honorably." —Radiant, archangel
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments." —Oracle *en*-Vec
When the alliance between Balduvia and Kjeldor deprived Stromgald of easy victories, its agents were forced to fuel their rituals with their own flesh.
There are medicines for all afflictions but idleness. —Suq'Ata saying
"I write upon clean white parchment with a sharp quill and the blood of my students, divining their secrets." —Shauku, Endbringer
"I am reminded of the fable of the silver egg. Its owner cracks it open to see what jewels it holds, only to discover a simple yellow yolk." —Karn, silver golem
"The final stage of the illness: delirium, convulsions, and death." —Phyrexian progress notes
"I will flay the skin from your flesh and the flesh from your bones and scrape your bones dry. And still you will not have suffered enough." —Greven *il*-Vec, to Gerrard
They exist to cease.
The grave robbers arrived the day after the burial. They were a day too late.
"For all the priceless tomes they have destroyed, one would think they would taste better." —Davvol, Evincar of Rath
A snap of fingers, a snap of teeth.
Part prison, part home.
Urza's metathran children were conceived, birthed, and nurtured by an integrated system of machines.
"While we fought, the *il* surrendered." —Oracle *en*-Vec
"The fishers will throw out their nets and draw them back filled with dust." —Oracle *en*-Vec
"Shiv hatched from a shell of stone around a yolk of flame." —Viashino myth
The helix was the finest example of Mishra's campaign strategy: if he couldn't have Argoth, no one could.
The key didn't work on a single lock, yet it opened many doors.
There is no glory to be gained in the kingdom of the dead. —Vec tomb inscription
Gatha survived as long as he did by giving all Keld's predators exactly what they wanted.
"My people are bound by masters centuries dead. Each artifact we destroy is another link broken in that chain." —Barb Tail, viashino heretic
"What we do not use up, we use again." —Urza
"One day we shall walk where once was water." —Eladamri, Lord of Leaves
One bone broken for every twig snapped underfoot. —Llanowar penalty for trespassing
"You want to know your enemy? Look at your feet while you trample him." —Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*
Bring the spear of ancient briar; Bring the torch to light the pyre. Bring the one who trod our ground; Bring the spade to dig his mound.
"But no one heard the snake's gentle hiss for peace over the elephant's trumpeting of war." —Afari, *Tales*
"Is it true that the apes wear furs of gold when they marry?" —Rana, Suq'Ata market fool
One pounce, she's hungry—you die quickly. Two, she's teaching her cubs—you're in for a long day.
"Here sprouted the first seedling of Argoth. Here the last tree will fall." —Gamelen, Citanul elder
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation." —Karn, silver golem
Rainclouds don't last long in Shiv, but that doesn't stop the lightning.
"I got it! I got it! I—"
"Shiv may be surrounded by water, but the mountains go far deeper." —Fire Eye, viashino bey
"The land promises nothing and keeps its promise." —Oracle *en*-Vec
Lightning tethers souls to the world. —Kor saying
